name: Oversized Polarized Sunglasses
note: These are the best affordable version of Jackie O style sunnies I have seen. My mom, sister, daughter and I all have a pair of these.

name: Trendy Shield Sunglasses
note: These are so affordable and they look so glam!

name: Cat Eye Sunglasses
note: My favorite cat-eye style sunglasses. I always have a spare pair of these in my car.

name: Woven Straw Sunglasses Case
note: I love the texture of this case, and it's nice and firm so your glasses stay completely protected.

name: Magnetic Sunglass Clip for Car Visor
note: I use these in my car. I love having an easy place to put my glasses where I can reach them.

name: Extra Wide Brim Straw Sun Hat
note: This hat is the ultimate in sun protection. The brim is extra wide. It works well for women and men too, and it is the best looking and most functional sun hat I have found.

name: Straw Visor (Packable!)
note: These straw visors are the best because you can roll them up and stick them in your bag. They're comfortable to adjust if you're wearing your hair up, and of course they block the sun from your face.

name: Kimono Swim Cover Up
note: These are the most versatile swim cover ups. Lots of colors and prints. You can wear it open or tied.

name: Tory Burch Pilot Sunglasses
note: These aviators look elevated. My sister has these and they are lovely when you want a dressier look.

name: Mini Lint Rollers, 3 Pack
note: A lint roller is a must! One on the dressing table, one in the bag and one in the car. Always!

name: Non-Slip Shoe Sole Grips
note: I stick these on the bottoms of all my sandals and heels. A quick and easy stylist trick that makes a world of difference for your comfort. Nobody likes to walk in a slippery shoe, and these instantly fix that.

name: Organizer Hangers, 2 Pack
note: These hangers have transformed my closet. I love to see everything hanging, and these save so much space. I use these for my fitness leggings.

name: 2-in-1 Handheld Travel Steamer
note: I am a huge fan of steamers and I have tried dozens of them. This one is my current favorite. It heats up fast and works well. I never even use an iron anymore, this does wonders and fast.

name: 3-Piece Luggage Set
note: This is hands down my favorite luggage set. It is unique because of the rectangular shape, which makes it easy to spot, and the wheels work well and it is lightweight. These are the best suitcases and I always recommend this set.

name: 15X Lighted Magnifying Mirror
note: The best lighted makeup mirror I have found. You can plug it in or use batteries. Excellent magnification and light, especially helpful for eye makeup. I travel with mine.

name: Full Length Mirror with Wheels
note: I tell all my clients you need a full length mirror to get dressed. This is the one I have. I love that it is on wheels so you can move it around.

name: Straw Tote with Adjustable Strap
note: I love the guitar strap on this casual bag. You can adjust the knot to make the strap longer or shorter.

name: Interchangeable Gold Purse Chains, 5 Pack
note: I absolutely love these interchangeable purse strap chains. You can turn a bag into a crossbody or a shoulder bag and instantly change your whole look.

name: Quilted Belt Bag
note: This is the one I travel with. Lightweight, adjustable, and it comes in lots of colors. Great for a walk around the neighborhood too. Perfect for your phone, glasses, keys, the essentials, and you can be hands free.

name: Crochet Handbag
note: Cute and trendy, super lightweight and fun. It is small so it works with certain outfits rather than every day, but it is unique and I always get asked about it.

name: HydroBag Crossbody Water Bottle Holder
note: The most stylish way to carry your water bottle and be hands free. I have one and I love the look of the adjustable guitar strap.

name: Smocked Maxi Sundress
note: This cute sundress comes in lots of gorgeous colors. Adjustable straps and pockets, an updated take on the smocked maxi.

name: Flowy Maxi Dress
note: This can be worn with or without a belt. Day or night. Great affordable dress. Comes in lots of colors.

name: High Waist Asymmetrical Wrap Midi Skirt
note: I love asymmetrical skirts. This one comes in several colors. It can be dressed up or down.

name: Tie Front Cotton Shirt
note: This top is 100% cotton and you can feel the softness. I love wearing the white one over a bathing suit while boating. It's also cute with high waisted jeans.

name: Mother Jeans, The Hustler Ankle Fray
note: These jeans hit that sweet spot of what is in style now, and they suit every age. I have a pair myself and I reach for them constantly. A great looking style and a cut a lot of people love.

name: Meg High-Rise Wide Leg Jeans
note: A great fit and a fun modern cut. I have had several clients try these on and they were all surprised at how good they look.

name: Maxi Shirt Dress
note: This dress comes in lots of colors and fun prints. You can tie it on the sides of your waist, or a bow or knot in the middle, which is my favorite. Affordable, comfortable and easy dress.

name: Lacoste Classic Polo
note: The ultimate preppy top. This classic comes in lots of colors. I especially love the crisp white one.

name: Lacoste Polo Dress
note: The cutest preppy shirt dress. So cute with sneakers, sunnies and a crossbody bag!

name: Arch Support Flip Flops
note: The most comfortable flip flop ever. I recommend the tan color. Beach, pool, yoga, these are the only pair of flip flops you really need. It's the arch support that is the difference.

name: Reef Slip-On Sandal
note: These are just so comfortable! They work well for walking around the house especially.

name: Lucky Espadrille Wedge Sandal
note: This is a popular all-purpose wedge. Comes in lots of colors and a comfortable easy height. I love espadrilles!

name: J. Renee Sandal
note: This is the shoe I have recommended to clients more than any other. It is sooo comfortable. I especially love the black ones, but I have them in every color. They are that good.

name: Sam Edelman Flat Mules
note: These are the best backless loafers. Lots of colors. Comfortable and stylish.

name: Heart Print Scarf Wrap
note: This lightweight scarf is adorable. I wear it year round, not just for Valentine's.

name: Soft Pashmina Wrap
note: I love pashminas for adding style and warmth. A must have when traveling. This one is soft and comes in many beautiful colors.

name: Cropped Cardigan
note: A cropped cardigan is a must have for chic layering. Perfect over a sleeveless dress or tank top when you are in cold air conditioning, and also great for a layer of modesty.

name: Cropped Cable Knit Sweater
note: This sweater is cropped at waist length, so it is not too short. It comes in lots of colors. I especially love the white one to wear with jeans and boots.

name: Classic Trench Coat
note: Incredible price for the most chic wardrobe addition. I have this one, and size down because it runs a little large. Perfect for both style and weather conditions.

name: Stretchy Stacking Bangles
note: These are stretchy, easy to wear, and fit beautifully. Not too big like most bangles. I like to stack 6 of them! They come in both gold and silver.

name: Ponytail Cuff, 4 Pack
note: This is like a cuff bracelet for your hair. The easiest way to make a simple hairstyle look elegant. Comes in gold, silver, or a mix of both.

name: Leather Teardrop Drop Earrings
note: Leather drop earrings add a little bit of edge to your outfit. These are surprisingly lightweight and come in different colors and shapes too.

name: Studded Leather Belt
note: I can never get enough studs. This belt comes in lots of colors, and it makes a jeans outfit look extra cool.

name: Turquoise Huggie Hoops
note: I love turquoise jewelry. I wear this pair myself at least once a week.

name: Silk Hair Ties, Set of 4
note: These are the best hair ties. They are made of real silk so they are soft and gentle on the hair. Lots of colors and a cute gift idea.

name: Butterluxe Adjustable Sports Bra
note: I love this adjustable and versatile sports bra. You can wear the straps straight or change them to criss cross. Many pretty colors to choose from, and you can even wear it as a sporty style bikini top to swim in too.

name: Butterluxe Twist Back Crop Tank Tops
note: These soft tanks have a built-in bra and adjustable straps. The cropped length works well with high waisted pants or shorts.

name: Fleece Thermal Leggings
note: These are for cold weather only! The fleece lining keeps you warm. Very warm! Lots of colors to choose from.

name: Butterluxe Leggings
note: Comfortable and flattering leggings. Lots of colors, these are some of my favorites and especially at this price.

name: Reebok Training Shoes
note: These are my favorite gym shoes. They give the right amount of stability for weight training.

name: Easycuffs for Rolling Up Your Sleeves
note: Stylists love to push up the sleeves. This is a trick to make the cuffs look more polished. Great for both men and women. You don't see or feel it, but it keeps the sleeves pushed up deliberately.

name: MicroStitch No-Sew Stitch Gun
note: A stitch gun is great for quick fixes. Stylists love them for minor alterations like closing the gap on a blouse. I don't use mine every day, but when I do, it saves the day!
